If you don’t agree, the app won’t connect to any server or send any of your information, and you won’t be able to use Tellomi until our mainland China service launches. You can close the app, or agree later.
Does my information leave mainland China?

Yes. Tellomi’s servers run in Alibaba Cloud’s data center in Hong Kong, China. Attachments, profile photos and server database backups are stored in Cloudflare R2 (storage region: western North America). Your chat history stays on your own devices, not on our servers.

· Tellomi’s servers in Hong Kong, operated by Chongqing Bange Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. (Hong Kong, China)
· Alibaba Cloud Computing Co., Ltd.: cloud servers for the above (Hong Kong data center)
· Cloudflare, Inc. (United States): storage of attachments, profile photos, database backups and debug logs; call relay; human verification at sign-up; DNS
· Google LLC (United States): push notifications (FCM), only on phones with Google services
· GIPHY, Inc. (United States): only when you use GIF search; receives your search terms through our Hong Kong proxy and can’t see your IP address
Personal information handler: Chongqing Bange Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. For questions about personal information protection or this transfer, email privacy@tellomi.app.

Signing up and signing in (including human verification); delivering and temporarily storing messages; storing attachments, profile photos and database backups; connecting voice and video calls (including call relay); push notifications; DNS; GIF search; keeping debug logs you choose to submit.
How it’s processed and how long it’s kept

Message content, profiles, group information and attachments are end-to-end encrypted. The servers and storage outside mainland China only hold ciphertext that neither Tellomi nor the recipients above can read. Only a few items are processed in plaintext, such as your phone number, account and device identifiers, push tokens and your IP address when connecting.\nRetention: account data is kept while your account exists and deleted when you delete your account; messages waiting for delivery are deleted as soon as they’re delivered; attachments are deleted 50 days after upload; server request logs are kept for 186 days. See section 22 of the Privacy Policy.

Phone number; account and device identifiers; public keys; push tokens (plus the Firebase installation ID on Android); IP address when connecting; hash of your username; browser and device information during human verification; encrypted messages, attachments, profile photos, profiles, group information and database backups (ciphertext); debug logs you choose to submit; search terms when you use GIF search.

You can access, copy, correct or delete your personal information, delete your account, or withdraw this consent as described in sections 26 and 27 of the Privacy Policy. For personal information processed by the recipients outside mainland China, you can also email privacy@tellomi.app, and we’ll handle it and coordinate with the recipient.

Under Article 5(4) of the Provisions on Promoting and Regulating Cross-Border Data Flows, a personal information handler other than a critical information infrastructure operator that has provided the personal information of fewer than 100,000 people (excluding sensitive personal information) outside mainland China since January 1 of the current year is exempt from the data export security assessment, the standard contract and personal information protection certification. Tellomi currently falls into this category; as the number approaches this threshold, we’ll complete the required procedure. The exemption doesn’t change our duties to inform you, obtain your separate consent and carry out a personal information protection impact assessment.

Tapping “Agree and Continue” means you separately consent to the transfer described above; agreeing to the Privacy Policy is not the same as consenting to this transfer. You can withdraw at any time by emailing privacy@tellomi.app (or in the app once that option is available). Because Tellomi can currently only be provided through servers outside mainland China, after withdrawing you won’t be able to keep using Tellomi until our mainland China service launches; you can also delete your account. Withdrawing doesn’t affect processing carried out before it.
